rootCause: The lone Circle floats half-clipped and disconnected from the grid, duplicating the lit cell without adding meaning — the beat is fully carried by the single igniting cell. Grid emphasis 'counterChange' is invalid for a grid with no counter, so ignition reads weakly; dormant cells also lack contrast for bright-light viewing.
changesMade: Removed the floating clipped Circle element (redundant duplicate of the grid's active cell)
Changed Grid emphasis from 'counterChange' to 'highlight' so the cell ignition reads as the emphasis beat
Set Grid density to 1 so dormant cells stay visible in bright conditions
expectedEffect: One unambiguous image: an empty grid with a single gold cell lighting up — 'today' and 'small' in one glance — with no clipped floating object competing for attention and a legible grid in bright light.
